arabic_text: وَفَازَ مَنْ تَمَسَّكَ بِكُمْ وَأَمِنَ مَنْ لَجَأَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَسَلِمَ مَنْ صَدَّقَكُمْ وَهُدِيَ مَنِ ٱعْتَصَمَ بِكُمْ
transliteration: wa fāza man tamassaka bikum. wa-amin(a) man laja'a ilaykum. wa salima man sadaqakum. wa hudhiya mani ʿtasama bikum.
english_text: winner is he who adheres to you, secured is he who resorts to you, saved is he who gives credence to you, and rightly guided is he who takes shelter in you.

arabic_text: مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمْ فَٱلْجَنَّةُ مَأْوَاهُ
transliteration: mani ʾattabaʿakum fal-jannatu maʾwah.
english_text: As to whoever follows you, Paradise will be his abode.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ خَالَفَكُمْ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَاهُ
transliteration: wa-man khalafakum fal-nāru mathwāhu.
english_text: As to whoever dissents you, Hellfire will be his dwelling.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ جَحَدَكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ مُشْرِكٌ وَمَنْ رَدَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي أَسْفَلِ دَرْكٍ مِنَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: wa man jahadakum kafirun. wa man ḥārabakum mushrikun wa man radda ʿalaykum fi asfali darkin min al-jahim.
english_text: He who denies you is unbeliever, he who makes war against you is polytheist, and he who objects to you will be in the lowest tier of the burning fire.

arabic_text: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ هٰذَا سَابِقٌ لَكُمْ فِيمَا مَضَىٰ وَجَارٍ لَكُمْ فِيمَا بَقِيَ
transliteration: ashhadu anna hadha sābiqun lakum fīmā maḍā. wa-jārin lakum fīmā baqiya.
english_text: I bear witness that all the previous was pre-decided for you and it will continue in the future;

arabic_text: وَأَنَّ أَرْوَاحَكُمْ وَنُورَكُمْ وَطينَتَكُمْ وَاحِدَةٌ
transliteration: wa anna arwāhakum wa nūrakum waṭīnatakum wāḥidah.
english_text: and that your souls, your light, and your form are the same;

arabic_text: طَابَتْ وَطَهُرَتْ بَعْضُهَا مِنْ بَعْضٍ
transliteration: tābat wa ṭahurat. baʿḍuhā min baʿḍin
english_text: blessed and purified, and one of the other.

arabic_text: خَلَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَنْوَاراً
transliteration: khalaqakumu allahu anwaran.
english_text: Allah created you as lights;

arabic_text: فَجَعَلَكُمْ بِعَرْشِهِ مُحْدِقِينَ حَتَّىٰ مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِكُمْ فَجَعَلَكُمْ فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ
transliteration: fajaʿalakum biʿarshihi muhdiqin. ḥattá mann ʿalaynā bikum. fajaʿalakum fee buyootin. 'aḏina allāhu 'an turfa'a.
english_text: He then made you observe from His Throne until He endued us with the favor of your existence (among us) and then placed you in houses that He allowed to be raised

arabic_text: وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُ
transliteration: wa yuzkara feeha ismuhu.
english_text: and to have His Name mentioned therein.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ صَلَوَاتِنَا عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَا خَصَّنَا بِهِ مِنْ وِلاَيَتِكُمْ طِيباً لِخَلْقِنَا وَطَهَارَةً لأَنْفُسِنَا
transliteration: wa jaʿala ṣalawātinā ʿalaykum wa mā khaṣṣanā bihi min wilāyatikum. ṭayyiban li-khalqinā. wa ṭahāratun li-anfusinā
english_text: He also decided our invocation of blessings upon you and our loyalty to you to be immaculacy of our creation, purity of our souls,

arabic_text: وَتَزْكِيَةً لَنَا وَكَفَّارَةً لِذُنُوبِنَا
transliteration: wa tazkiyatān lanā. wa kaffāratan li dhunūbinā.
english_text: refinement of our manners, and forgiveness of our sins.

arabic_text: فَكُنَّا عِنْدَهُ مُسَلِّمِينَ بِفَضْلِكُمْ وَمَعْرُوفِينَ بِتَصْدِيقِنَا إِيَّاكُمْ
transliteration: fa kunna 'indahu muslimīn bi-faḍlikum. wa maʿrufīn bi taṣdīqinā iyyākum.
english_text: We have thus become, with Him, of those believing in your precedence and of those known for their giving credence to you.

arabic_text: فَبَلَغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمْ أَشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ وَأَعْلَىٰ مَنَازِلِ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَأَرْفَعَ دَرَجَاتِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ حَيْثُ لَا يَلْحَقُهُ لاَحِقٌ
transliteration: fa balagha allāhu bikum ashrafah ma hallil mukarramin. wa'aʿla manāzili almuqarrabīn. wa-arfa'a darajat al-mursalīn. ḥaythu lā yalḥaquhu lāḥiqun.
english_text: Thus, Allah has raised you to the most principled place of the honored ones, the highest station of those drawn near to Him, and the loftiest ranks of the Messengers where none can ever reach you,

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَفُوقُهُ فَائِقٌ وَلاَ يَسْبِقُهُ سَابِقٌ وَلاَ يَطْمَعُ فِي إِدْرَاكِهِ طَامِعٌ
transliteration: walā yafūquhu fāʾiqun. walā yasbiquhu sābiqun. wala yatmaʿu fi idrakihi tamiʿun.
english_text: nor can anyone ever surpass you, nor can anyone ever precede you, no can anyone ever look forward to reaching your positions;

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰ لَا يَبْقَىٰ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلاَ نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ وَلاَ صِدِّيقٌ وَلاَ شَهِيدٌ وَلاَ عَالِمٌ وَلاَ جَاهِلٌ
transliteration: ḥattá lā yabqá malakun muqarrabun. wa lā nabiyyun mursalun. wa lā ṣiddīqun wa lā shahīdun. wa lā ʿālimun wa lā jāhilun.
english_text: therefore, no archangel, commissioned Prophet, a veracious one, a martyr, a knowledgeable one, an ignorant one,

arabic_text: وَلاَ دَنِيٌّ وَلاَ فَاضِلٌ وَلاَ مُؤْمِنٌ صَالِحٌ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ طَالِحٌ وَلاَ جَبَّارٌ عَنِيدٌ
transliteration: walā daniyyun walā fādilun. walā muʾminun ṣāliḥun. walā fājirun ṭāliḥun. walā jabbarun ʿanīdun
english_text: an inferior, a superior, a righteous believer, a wicked sinner, an obstinate tyrant,

arabic_text: وَلاَ شَيْطَانٌ مَرِيدٌ وَلاَ خَلْقٌ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ شَهِيدٌ إِلاَّ عَرَّفَهُمْ جَلاَلَةَ أَمْرِكُمْ وَعِظَمَ خَطَرِكُمْ
transliteration: wa la shaytanun marid. walā khalqun fīmā bayna dhālika shahīdun. illa 'arrafahum jalalata amrikum. wa 'iẓama khaṭarikum.
english_text: a devilish rebel, or any other witnessing being among these classes—all of those were informed by Allah about the majesty of your issue, the importance of your standing,

arabic_text: وَكِبَرَ شَأْنِكُمْ وَتَمَامَ نُورِكُمْ وَصِدْقَ مَقَاعِدِكُمْ وَثَبَاتَ مَقَامِكُمْ
transliteration: wa kibara sha'nukum wa tamāma nūrikum. wa ṣidqa maqāʿidikum. wa thabāta maqāmikum.
english_text: the greatness of your prestige, the thoroughness of your illumination, the honesty of your position, the firmness of your stance,

arabic_text: وَشَرَفَ مَحَلِّكُمْ وَمَنْزِلَتِكُمْ عِنْدَهُ وَكَرَامَتَكُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَخَاصَّتَكُمْ لَدَيْهِ وَقُرْبَ مَنْزِلَتِكُمْ مِنْهُ
transliteration: wa sharafa mahallukum wa manzilatikum ʿindahu. wa karāmatakum ʿalayhi wa khassatakum ladayhi. wa qurb manzilatikum minhu
english_text: the honor of your station and position with Him, your upstanding reputation with Him, your special position with Him, and your close location to Him.

arabic_text: بِأَبِي أَنْتُمْ وَأُمَّي وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي وَأُسْرَتِي
transliteration: bi-abi antum wa ummi. wa ahli wa maali wa usrati.
english_text: May my father, my mother, my kin, my property, and my family be ransoms for you.

arabic_text: أُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَأُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي مُؤْمِنٌ بِكُمْ وَبِمَا آمَنْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرٌ بَعَدُوِّكُمْ وَبِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ مُسْتَبْصِرٌ بِشَأْنِكُمْ
transliteration: 'ušhidu allāh wa 'ušhidukum. 'annī mu'minun bikum wabimā āmantum bihī kāfirun baʿaduwwikum wabimā kafartum bihi mustabṣirun bi-sha'anikum.
english_text: I beseech Allah and I beseech you all to witness for me that I believe in you all and in that in which you believe, I renounce your enemies and whatever you renounce, I am fully aware of your matter

arabic_text: وَبِضَلاَلَةِ مَنْ خَالَفَكُمْ مُوَالٍ لَكُمْ وَلأَوْلِيَائِكُمْ مُبْغِضٌ لأَعْدَائِكُمْ وَمُعَادٍ لَهُمْ سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سَالَمَكُمْ
transliteration: wa bidhalalati man khalafakum. muwālin lakum wal-awliyā'ikum. mubghidhun li-a'daa'ikum wa mu'adin lahum. silmun liman salamakum.
english_text: and of the deviation of those who oppose you, I am loyalist to you and to your loyalists, I hate your enemies and I show enmity towards them, I am at peace with those who make peace with you,

arabic_text: وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ مُحَقِّقٌ لِمَا حَقَّقْتُمْ مُبْطِلٌ لِمَا أَبْطَلْتُمْ مُطِيعٌ لَكُمْ
transliteration: wa ḥarbun liman ḥārabakum muhaqqiqun lima haqqaqtum. mubṭilun limā abṭaltum. muṭīʿun lakum.
english_text: I take the field against those who march against you, I accept as true that which you have decided as true, I prove false that which you have decided as false, I am obedient to you,

arabic_text: عَارِفٌ بِحَقِّكُمْ مُقِرٌّ بِفَضْلِكُمْ مُحْتَمِلٌ لِعِلْمِكُمْ مُحْتَجِبٌ بِذِمَّتِكُمْ
transliteration: ʿārifun bi-ḥaqqikum. muqirrun bifadlikum. muhtamilun li'il-mikum. muḥtajibun bi dhimmatikum.
english_text: I recognize your right, I confess of your superiority, I preserve your knowledge, I take refuge under your protective shelter,

arabic_text: مُعْتَرِفٌ بِكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ بِإِيَابِكُمْ مُصَدِّقٌ بِرَجْعَتِكُمْ مُنْتَظِرٌ لأَمْرِكُمْ
transliteration: muʿtarifun bikum mu'minun bi-iyaabikum. muṣaddiqun bi-rajaʿatikum. muntaẓirun li-amrikum.
english_text: I profess you, I believe in your coming back (to this world), I give credence to your return, I am awaiting your issue,

arabic_text: مُرْتَقِبٌ لِدَوْلَتِكُمْ آخِذٌ بِقَوْلِكُمْ عَامِلٌ بِأَمْرِكُمْ مُسْتَجِيرٌ بِكُمْ
transliteration: murtaqibun lidawlatikum. ʾākhidhun biqawlikum. ʿamilun bi-amrikum. mustajīrun bikum.
english_text: I am expecting your rule, I take in your sayings, I carry out your orders, I take shelter in you,

arabic_text: زَائِرٌ لَكُمْ لاَئِذٌ عَائِذٌ بِقُبُورِكُمْ مُسْتَشْفِعٌ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِكُمْ وَمُتَقَرِّبٌ بِكُمْ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: zāʾirun lakum. lāʾiẓun ʿāʾiẓun biqubūrikum. mustashfi'un ila allahi `azza wa jall bi-kum. wa mutaqarrabun bikum ilayhi.
english_text: I make visits to you I resort to and seek protection in your graves, I seek your intercession for me with Allah the Almighty and All-majestic, I seek nearness to Him in your names,

arabic_text: وَمُقَدِّمُكُمْ أَمَامَ طَلِبَتِي وَحَوَائِجِي وَإِرَادَتِي فِي كُلِّ أَحْوَالِي وَأُمُورِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِسِرِّكُمْ وَعَلاَنِيَتِكُمْ
transliteration: wa muqaddimukum amaama talibati. waḥawāʾijī wa-irādatī. fī kulli aḥwālī wa umūrī muʾminun bi sirrikum wa ʿalanīyatikum.
english_text: I provide you as my means for seeking fulfillment of my desires, needs, and wishes, in all of my manners and affairs, I believe in your invisibility, visibility,

arabic_text: وَشَاهِدِكُمْ وَغَائِبِكُمْ وَأَوَّلِكُمْ وَآخِرِكُمْ
transliteration: wa shāhidikum wa ghā'ibikum. wa'awwalikum wa akhirikum.
english_text: presence, absence, first, and last of you;
